# `FluxRuntimeHost::add_gas`

<span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge-ABI">ABI</span> <span class="sdk-kind">method</span>

Source: **ABI v4** (`src/plugins/abi.rs`). Generated group: **Methods**.

## Description

Adds free gas with the requested velocity and returns the amount the host accepted.

## Signature

```rust
fn add_gas (& mut self , cell : UVec2 , substance : & str , amount : u32 , velocity : Vec2 ,) -> Result < u32 , FluxStatus >
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `cell` | UVec2 | `cell` argument passed as `UVec2`. |
| `substance` | & str | `substance` argument passed as `& str`. |
| `amount` | u32 | `amount` argument passed as `u32`. |
| `velocity` | Vec2 | `velocity` argument passed as `Vec2`. |

## Return Value

## SDK Example

_Source: [`examples/methods/fluxruntimehost-add-gas.md`](../../examples/methods/fluxruntimehost-add-gas.md)_

```rust
fn vent_hydrogen(host: &mut FluxRuntimeHost, cell: UVec2) -> FluxStatus {
    let velocity = Vec2::new(2.0, 0.0);
    let added = match host.add_gas(cell, "h2", 25, velocity) {
        Ok(added) => added,
        Err(status) => return status,
    };
    println!("added {added} hydrogen particles");
    FluxStatus::OK
}
```
